responsibility: Implements parsing and semantic analysis for the built-in `format_args!`, `format_args_nl!`, and `const_format_args!` macros. It parses the macro argument list, interprets the format string and placeholders, resolves positional, named, and implicit arguments, validates formatting options and references, emits lints and diagnostics, and builds the `FormatArgs` AST node that later lowering turns into `core::fmt::Arguments`.
